data.name: Magical Girl Taboo Village
data.detailed_description:
English localization is currently in preparation.

We are aiming to make it available as close to the Japanese release as possible, while ensuring the quality of the story experience.

◆ Story

Watanuki Sakuya awakens in an old shrine.

Before her hangs the corpse of a girl, flowers blooming from every part of her body.

She had only come to the village with her best friend for a certain purpose.

What has happened to her?

The nine other girls still alive inside the shrine each have a flower blooming from one eye.

Before long, a caretaker girl named Yumemi appears and explains the situation.

“You are magical girls chosen for the Kamibana.

Every night at 8 PM, during the Flower Offering Ritual,

one girl will be chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged.”

◆ Game Introduction

A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel set in a village bound by ancient customs.

In a sealed village, a ritual is repeated night after night:

a girl is chosen and offered to a god.

Set in a village both beautiful and grotesque,

the magical girls struggle to survive as they uncover the ancient customs hidden within the village

and draw closer to the true nature of the Kamibana.

Who created this ritual?

And for what purpose?

A story where magic and mystery intertwine begins.

A multifaceted story where the truth turns inside out.

The village’s hidden customs.

The secrets carried by each girl.

Through countless chains of cause and consequence,

the story reveals a different face each time its perspective shifts.

What you believed to be true may be only one side of the truth.

data.short_description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, English
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Generic Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 6144 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Recent DirectX 11-capable GPUs (incl. Integrated Graphics)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6144 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan graphic API available via `-force-vulkan` argument for diagnosing purpose. All the information here may subject to change without prior notice. 64-bit processor and operating system required.

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700 (8 cores / 16 threads)
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10240 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Provisional information as per development validation. Subject to change in the future when further optimization is implemented. 64-bit processor and operating system required.

  • Memory: 6144 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPUs
  • Storage: 6144 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: All the information here may subject to change without prior notice.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences.

The content includes the following elements:
fantasy/mild violence, blood, violent acts, accidental death, bodily injury, corpses, violence descriptions, killing, torture, detailed depictions of death, depictions of suicide, depictions of violent acts, fear, psychological horror, and mild swearing.

If you may feel discomfort with any of the topics listed above, please refrain from playing the game.

However, most depictions of violence and blood are presented through artistic and unrealistic imagery rather than realistic portrayals.

Additionally, the game does not use jump scare-style effects, in order to reduce psychological impact while preserving the atmosphere of the work.
